result.summary: The interface displays several layout and logical inconsistencies regarding filtering and text rendering.

issues.description: Active filter 'Pizza' does not match visible content, which displays Poké, Burgers, and Ramen.
issues.suggestion: Sync displayed results with the active category selection.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs on 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Implement flexible container widths or font scaling to avoid truncation.

issues.description: Low-fidelity vector illustrations used instead of high-quality product photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic clip-art icons with realistic food images for better UX.
